content: The solution contains 9% sodium chloride and appears off-white to light brown in color. Storage Instructions: Unopened vials should be stored at refrigeration temperatures between 2°C and 8°C. Protect the vials from light exposure. Keep the vials in their original carton until they are ready to be used. Vials are intended for single use only. Once opened, any unused drug must be discarded. Drug Images and Label Information: The drug label includes images of the packaging and labeling display panel. The principal display panel provides details about the ingredients and appearance of the product. Patient Counseling Information: There is limited information available in the drug label regarding patient counseling for Beractant. Precautions with Alcohol: The interaction between alcohol and Beractant has not been established. Patients are advised to consult their doctor regarding the potential effects of consuming alcohol while using this medication. Brand Name: The medication is marketed under the brand name Survanta®. Look-Alike Drug Names: There is limited information in the drug label regarding potential look-alike drug names for Beractant.
